cases.prompt: Write an Espresso test in Kotlin for our LoginActivity (fields email, password, button login, shows text "Welcome").
expectations: Uses typeText and closeSoftKeyboard then click.
Checks the result with matches(isDisplayed()) or withText.

cases.prompt: My Espresso test fails because a network call has not finished. Thread.sleep fixes it. What is the better way?
expectations: Recommends an IdlingResource (CountingIdlingResource or OkHttp idling resource).
Explains why Thread.sleep is slow and unreliable.
